verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus documents writing your own HTML for emails and dynamically personalising content with subscriber data, which covers the HTML-with-variable-substitution part of the story. The documented API covers contacts, lists, campaign reports and automations but no template endpoints, so templates cannot be shown to be API-managed or kept in version control. Missing for 10: API endpoints to create or update templates, MJML support, version-control or Git integration, documented variable/merge-tag syntax, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control

citations.quote: Write your own HTML or use our drag and drop editor
Dynamically personalise your subject lines and content, using data from your subscribers
